answer: Quadratic staking with proof-of-personhood blocks Sybils: each attested human runs one agent, and voting weight is the square root of its locked stake. Splitting a wallet into a hundred fake ones adds no weight, since the registry traces funding ancestry and counts linked wallets as one. Doubling influence costs four times the bond, which is slashed on any confirmed duplicate. At dawn an honest agent clears the canyon of verification and reclaims its bond at harbor, while the forger pays an unrefundable premium for every fake identity.
